newsitem.title: USA: News Corp exploring joint venture - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News Corp exploring joint venture - WSJ.

text.p: Rupert Murdoch, chief executive of News Corp, said the company is exploring a "joint venture" with prospective partners for its HarperCollins unit, a decision that would cut News Corp's stake in the book publisher.
In Tuesday's electronic edition of the Wall Street Journal, the paper said Murdoch denied rumors that News Corp wants to sell all of HarperCollins.
Murdoch declined to identify the companies he is talking with, the paper said.
The article said "people in the publishing industry" said Bantam Doubleday Dell Publishing Group Inc is the most likely investor in HarperCollins.
The company had no comment, the Journal said.
